cases.label: Case 1 — Lung Adenocarcinoma (EGFR exon 19 del)
cases.clinical_notes: 68-year-old Asian female non-smoker. Incidental right upper lobe nodule found on screening CT. Progressive cough and mild dyspnea x 3 months. No constitutional symptoms. ECOG PS 1. No prior thoracic surgery. Chest CT shows 2.4 cm part-solid nodule with ground-glass opacity component, right upper lobe, without satellite nodules. Mediastinal staging PET/CT shows no FDG-avid mediastinal or hilar nodes. Clinical stage IA3 (T2aN0M0).

expected_findings.concordance: Concordant — part-solid GGO nodule consistent with EGFR-mutant LUAD

cases.label: Case 2 — Glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype, MGMT methylated)
cases.clinical_notes: 55-year-old male presenting with 6-week history of progressive right-sided weakness and expressive aphasia. MRI brain with contrast shows 4.8 cm ring-enhancing mass in the left temporal-parietal lobe with extensive surrounding FLAIR signal abnormality (edema). Central necrosis on T1 post-contrast. Mass effect with 8mm midline shift. Gross total resection achieved. KPS 70. No prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy.

expected_findings.treatment: Stupp protocol: TMZ 75mg/m2 + RT 60Gy/30fx, then adjuvant TMZ x6 cycles + TTFields (Optune)
expected_findings.concordance: Concordant — ring-enhancing mass with necrosis consistent with IDH-wildtype GBM

cases.label: Case 3 — Breast Cancer — ⚠️ DISCORDANCE ALERT
cases.clinical_notes: 47-year-old female. Palpable left breast mass discovered on self-exam. Mammogram: 3.1 cm irregular mass with spiculated margins, left upper outer quadrant. MRI: heterogeneous enhancement with rapid washout kinetics. No axillary adenopathy on imaging. Core needle biopsy from dominant lesion. IHC: ER+, PR+, HER2-negative (IHC 1+, FISH non-amplified). Genomic sequencing from same biopsy. NOTE: Imaging phenotype (aggressive enhancement, rapid washout, spiculation) does not match expected IHC/genomic profile. Prior radiology report questioned biopsy adequacy.

genomic_summary.molecular_subtype: PIK3CA-mutant — ⚠️ ERBB2 amplification detected (discordant with IHC HER2-)
tier1_actionable: ERBB2 amplification → HER2-targeted therapy (if confirmed by repeat testing)

expected_findings.treatment: ⚠️ HOLD — Repeat HER2 testing required. If HER2+ confirmed: Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab + Taxane. If PIK3CA dominant: Alpelisib + endocrine therapy.
expected_findings.concordance: ⚠️ DISCORDANT — MRI shows aggressive HER2-like phenotype but IHC HER2-negative. NGS shows ERBB2 amplification. Biopsy sampling error or intratumoral heterogeneity suspected.
